args.title: Use config.publicUrl for email link BASE_URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL to construct BASE_URL, aligning email links with the configured application URL rather than defaulting to localhost.
